title: Dashboard Home Screen — Tile-Based Command Center
goal: Make the Dashboard the first screen operators see — a tile-based command center showing active runs, combined risk posture, open problems, upcoming scans, and recent activity across all engagements at a glance.
scope: Add a Dashboard screen as the default landing screen (replaces the wizard as the starting view when engagements exist). The Dashboard is accessible via a 'home' icon at the top of the sidebar. Layout uses a responsive tile grid with the following tiles/widgets: (1) ACTIVE RUN TILE (full-width if run active, hidden if none): shows current run name, phase progress, tasks running/done, live finding counter with severity colours. Links to Mission Control. (2) RISK SCORE TILE: current exposure score gauge (0-100) with trend arrow (improving/stable/worsening) and sparkline for last 7 runs. Links to History. (3) OPEN PROBLEMS TILE: count of open critical/high/medium findings across ALL engagements. Critical count in red, prominent. Links to Problems Center (backlog-84). (4) UPCOMING SCANS TILE: next 3 scheduled runs with engagement name, profile, and ETA. Links to Settings > Schedules. (5) RECENT ACTIVITY FEED: last 10 events across all engagements (new findings, completed runs, remediated items, new scans). Time-relative timestamps. (6) QUICK ACTIONS TILE: 4 action buttons: [+ New Mission], [View Findings], [Download Report], [View All Engagements]. (7) SETUP CHECKLIST (shown until all items done, from backlog-80 onboarding): compact card showing completion status. (8) ENGAGEMENTS SUMMARY: table of last 5 active engagements with columns: name, last run date, risk score, open critical/high counts, and quick-link arrow. GET /api/v1/dashboard provides all widget data in a single API call to avoid waterfall loading.
generation_reason: AegisPT has no home screen. Opening the app drops you into the wizard whether or not you have existing data. A dashboard is the first thing enterprise buyers expect. NodeZero, Pentera, and Cobalt all have dashboard home screens. The dashboard makes AegisPT feel like a platform, not a scanner.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Read-only aggregate dashboard. No new write operations. Single /api/v1/dashboard endpoint aggregates existing data. Dashboard replaces wizard as default only when engagements exist — new operators still see onboarding/wizard first.

success_criteria: Dashboard screen appears as default landing when engagements exist.
Wizard remains the default when no engagements exist.
All 7 tiles/widgets render with correct data.
GET /api/v1/dashboard returns all widget data in a single call.
Active run tile shows live data when a run is active.
Risk score tile shows exposure score and trend.
Open problems tile shows cross-engagement finding counts.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Single API call loads all widget data.
Default routing correct per engagement existence.

before_promotion: Bulk delete (backlog-82) is completed and logged.
after_completion: Update CURRENT_STATE.md with Dashboard as active home screen.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
